Dave Matthews Band
June 15, 1997
Nissan Pavilion at Stone Ridge
Bristow, VA


Taper: Unknown
Location: 5th Row, Left Stack 
Source: Coresound Cardioids>Sony TCD-D8 (@16/32kHz)
Transfer: DAT>Tascam DA-20>Edirol UA5 (Digi-mod)>USB>PC 
Conversion: Tom Gambichler-DAT>Sound Forge 8,Recorded @ 16/32kHz,Resampled to 16/44kHz, Fade in & fade out applied>L3 Waves Volume Maximizer>CD Wav Editor for track splitting>WAV>Flac Frontend, compression @ level 5

**************DO NOT ENCODE THIS SHOW TO LOSSY FORMATS*****************
****************DO NOT SELL OR DISTRIBUTE FOR PROFIT*******************

Received this DAT from Tye on Taperssection.com and it was well preserved over the years.  Thanks to Tye for sending me this DAT to convert. The taper recorded this in 16 bit/32kHz instead of the normal 16/44 or 16/48.  The quality or dynamic range might not be as good as a result.  It was probably recorded this way to save space on the DAT tape if the show exceeded 2 hours. However, after converting and tracking this show, it sounds VERY good.  You be the judge.


Errors:
-------
Slight skip at 1:56 of Crash, pop at 8:20 of Ants (fixed with Sound Forge pencil tool)
